hypotheses.justification: Only preservation of existing sheaf limits is needed, not existence of all limits in C. Mathlib's CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf shows that composing each C-valued sheaf with forget C is a sheaf using the retained limit-preservation assumption alone. Apply TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf.isSheafUniqueGluing_types to obtain elementwise gluing and uniqueness, replacing the concrete-category gluing/local-equality calls here and in explicitSectionsComparison_injective. All other steps remain unchanged. This also handles empty covers and U = ∅. This hypothesis and instReflectsIsomorphisms can both be deleted.

Reflection is unnecessary because the proof only transfers sheafness from C-valued presheaves to their underlying type-valued presheaves, never conversely. Use CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf, which requires preservation of limits but not reflection, followed by TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf.isSheafUniqueGluing_types. Replace the gluing/local-equality calls both here and in explicitSectionsComparison_injective accordingly. The remaining steps need no reflection. Unique gluing includes the empty-cover case, so empty U causes no exception. This hypothesis and HasLimitsOfSize can both be deleted.
